notes: Bombay Coffee House has more than one outlet. The travell.cc work-cafe guide rates a Bombay Coffee House in Ballard Estate, Fort (wifi good, sockets yes, 8:30am–11pm) — that is a different branch, so it was deliberately excluded from the evidence above. All evidence cited here is tied to the 248 Waterfield Road / Neelkamal Building address. Tripadvisor rates this branch 4.0 from 76 reviews; the higher-volume Google figure was used for publicRating. Reviewers note a 10% service charge, water served only on request, and difficult parking. Zomato fetch blocked by robots.txt.

notes: Closing time conflicts: district.in says 11pm, magicpin says 11:30pm. Kitchen Garden by Suzette has several Mumbai outlets (BKC/Bandra East, Juhu, Santacruz, Mulund); only sources tied to the Gasper Enclave, St John Street / Pali Naka address were used. Ratings vary widely by platform: district.in 3.7 from 711 ratings, Tripadvisor 4.0 from 42 reviews, magicpin 4.4 from only 7 ratings — the largest sample was used. The LBB review confirms counter-ordering with table numbers but adds no workability detail; the official suzette.in homepage does not list this outlet's address or hours. Zomato and foursquare fetches blocked by robots.txt. Weakest workability evidence of the five cafes: no first-hand account of anyone working here was found.

notes: Trading status positively confirmed: Tripadvisor shows no closure flag and magicpin lists the Sanatan Pereira Bungalow, 36/A St John Baptist Road address as currently open; no source found suggesting closure. Address discrepancy: Tripadvisor's listing gives '102 St John Baptist Road' while magicpin gives '36/A' — same street, treated as the same venue. Hours conflict: Tripadvisor 7:30am–11:30pm, magicpin 8am–11pm; socialmaharaj independently corroborates the 7:30am opening. Ratings vary: Tripadvisor 4.4 from 208 reviews (used), magicpin 4.6 from only 32 ratings. Magicpin lists live music as a feature, which could undercut focus at certain times — no source dates or times it. Operated by Hindustan Unilever, opened September 2015. Zomato and foursquare fetches blocked by robots.txt.
